title: Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess
description:
Descrição
O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.Responsabilidades
Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades Requeridas
Proficiência em mandarim
Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;
Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.Atributos
Proatividade;
Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Trabalho em equipe;
Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
Senso de urgência;
Multitarefa;
Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Software engineer iii
description:
Top 3 habilidades técnicas obrigatórias:Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e microsserviços, frameworks Java Script e banco de dados SQL/PostgresVisão geral da posição
ComoEngenheiro(a) de Software Principalna equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA
Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations
Company: Fulcrum Saa S
Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)
Type: Full-time
Level:  Senior / Staff
Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location
About Fulcrum Saa S
Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.
Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.
The Role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.
You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.
You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.
What You’ll Do
Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.
What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)
5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).
Strong Nice-to-Haves
Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.
What We Offer
Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.
How to Apply
Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:
Your experience with Go in production.
The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.

A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.

title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.
Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.
Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests

Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria
Software de gestão de construção que serve como sua única fonte de verdade para cada projeto.

·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases

Excellent organizational and time-management skills

Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

title: Gtm builder
description:
GTM builder
You are an AI-native builder. You don’t just use AI tools; you build agents, copilots, and autonomous systems. You understand how modern LLMs actually work: tool use, reasoning loops, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and orchestration. You are comfortable vibe-coding, shipping fast, and learning new AI tooling weekly. You’ve built side projects, internal tools, or production systems using LLMs, agents, or automation frameworks. You think in systems, not scripts. You’ll be responsible for building A...
You know that the leverage of a single great AI builder today is 10–100x a traditional engineer. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.
You Will:
• Design and deploy autonomous AI agents that can research, reason, and execute real business workflows
• Build agentic systems using modern LLM capabilities including tool use, function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning
• Create internal AI copilots used daily by marketing, sales and operations
• Implement retrieval systems (RAG) using embeddings and vector databases to give agents context and memory
• Build AI workflows that can enrich accounts, qualify leads, generate insights, and automate execution
• Integrate AI agents deeply into our stack: Hub Spot, internal databases, enrichment platforms, and product systems
• Automate workflows that previously required human operational effort
• Build scraping, parsing, and AI extraction systems to convert unstructured web data into structured intelligence
• Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy new AI capabilities as new models and tools become available
• Continuously improve agents to make them faster, smarter, cheaper, and more reliable
• Build reusable internal frameworks, tools, and agent architectures
• Own systems end-to-end — from idea to production
You Have:
• Strong software engineering ability and the ability to ship working systems quickly
• Hands-on experience building with modern LLMs and AI tools (Open AI, Anthropic, open models, or similar)
• Experience building AI agents, copilots, or automated workflows
• Strong prompt engineering skills and understanding of structured prompting and reliability
• Experience integrating APIs, webhooks, and external systems
• Ability to work with structured and unstructured data
• Experience with automation tools like N8 N, Make, Zapier, or similar
• Comfort working with web scraping, enrichment systems, and data pipelines
• Strong builder mindset — you learn fast, experiment fast, and ship fast
• High agency — you figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions
• Curiosity and obsession with new AI capabilities
• Bonus: Experience with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval systems
• Bonus: Experience building multi-step agent workflows
• Bonus: You actively build AI projects outside of work
• Bonus: You use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

title: Senior voip engineer
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Vo IP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.
This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.
What you'll do
Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability. What we're looking for:
Required 5+ years as a developer building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack: A B2 BUA / media server: Asterisk or Free SWITCH
A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or Open SIPS
Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong plus Python for automation, tooling, or service development. SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).
Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.
Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.
Why this role
Fully remote with a flexible working model.
Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Lifecycle & retention strategist (klaviyo)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY
ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, Tik Tok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.
We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth e Commerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.
You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.
You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.
This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.
SCOPE OF WORK
Strategy and Campaign Planning
Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth e Commerce brands
Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and Click Up timelines on track
Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities Optimization and Performance
Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training Tech Stack Management and Recommendations
Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, Loyalty Lion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, After Ship), push notifications, and direct mail (Post Pilot, Paper Run, etc.)
Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team Client Collaboration
Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within e Commerce or DTC
Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
Solid understanding of the e Commerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
Proficiency with Click Up (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite
NICE TO HAVE
Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud
HOW WE WORK
You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through Click Up for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

title: Commercial lead — brazil
description:
About Regrow
Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.

About the Role
As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.
This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.

What You’ll Do
Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
What You’ll Bring
Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.
Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.
Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
Nice to Have
Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
Working knowledge of Spanish.
Why Regrow
Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
 
Acerca de Regrow
Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.
Sobre el Rol
Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.
Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.
Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.
Qué Harás
Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Qué Aportarás
Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.
Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.
Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Deseable
Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
Conocimiento funcional del español.
Por Qué Regrow
Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Digital marketing ad strategist
description:
The Digital Marketing Ad Strategist is a responsible for the performance, health, and scalability of paid advertising accounts across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and Linked In Ads. This role is heavily focused on account audits, ongoing optimization, technical troubleshooting, and performance improvements.
You will analyze existing ad accounts, identify inefficiencies and technical issues, recommend and implement fixes, and ensure tracking, structure, and strategy are aligned with business objectives.
Requirements
In-depth knowledge of the following platforms: Google ads, Facebook Ads, Microsoft Ads
Detail oriented
Key Responsibilities
Account Audits & Diagnostics
 • Conduct in-depth audits of Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft, and Linked In Ads accounts. Experience or working knowledge across secondary platforms, including Tik Tok, Pinterest, Reddit, X, Snapchat, Spotify, and Amazon.
 • Identify structural issues, wasted spend, tracking gaps, and performance blockers
 • Diagnose bugs and technical issues such as:
 • Incorrect or missing conversion tracking
 • Pixel or tag misfires
 • Attribution and reporting discrepancies
 • Budget pacing and delivery issues
 • Audience overlap and campaign cannibalization
 • Document findings and deliver clear, prioritized optimization recommendations
 Optimization & Performance Management
  • Continuous proactive optimization of campaigns, ad groups, keywords, audiences, bids, and creatives
 • Improve key performance metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate
 • Manage and reallocate budgets based on performance and growth opportunities
 • Plan and execute A/B tests across targeting, creative, offers, and landing pages
 • Optimize accounts across full-funnel stages (awareness, consideration, conversion)
 Strategy & Execution
 • Translate business goals into effective paid media strategies
 • Ensure account structures align with funnel intent and buyer journeys
 • Align ad messaging with audience intent and platform best practices
 Tracking, Data & Reporting
 • Ensure accurate setup and ongoing validation of conversion tracking
 • Work with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and platform analytics to confirm data integrity
 • Analyze performance data to uncover insights, issues, and opportunities
 • Create performance reports that clearly explain results, risks, and next steps
 Process & Quality Control
  • Maintain clean account structure, naming conventions, and documentation
 • Build and follow optimization and audit checklists
 • Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and best practices
 • Proactively flag risks, inefficiencies, or declining performance trends
Additional Tasks
 • Forecasts and initial ad spend recommendations to assist with the Sales team.
 • Have basic design knowledge and be able to coordinate ad copy and creative with internal team members.
Language Requirements
 • Fluent in English and Portuguese
Salary
$3000 BRL (Brazilian Real) / Per Month to start
Benefits after 6 months
Hiring Process:
Initial Interview with small knowledge test
Second interview with Ads team
Possible follow up questions / test
Final meet and greet meeting
